name: Peregrine
tagline: A propellant leak ended its Moon flight; it re-entered over the Pacific
description: Peregrine is Astrobotic's lunar lander for NASA's Commercial Lunar Payload Services. It flew on the first Vulcan Centaur, on 2024-01-08, with five main engines of 667 N each and pressure-fed MMH and MON-25 propellants, and was meant to put 70 to 90 kg of payload on the Moon. A helium valve lost its seal after separation, an oxidiser tank ruptured, and the landing was called off. It reached the Moon's distance on about 2024-01-12 and was steered into a controlled re-entry over the South Pacific on 2024-01-18, after 10 days 14 hours of flight.
best_known_for: A propellant leak ended its Moon flight; it re-entered over the Pacific
